options.name: title
options.description: Accessible name, rendered as the heading.

options.name: content
options.description: Body content; strings render as text.

options.name: actions
options.description: Footer buttons; clicking closes with the action value.

options.name: modal
options.description: true: showModal() with inert background, backdrop and scroll lock. false: show(); background stays interactive (supplementary panels only).

options.name: placement
options.description: Screen edge; start/end follow the writing direction.

options.name: size
options.description: Inline size for side drawers; maximum block size (capped at 85dvh) for top/bottom.

options.name: closeOnEscape
options.description: Escape requests close (cancelable) when the drawer is the topmost overlay.

options.name: closeOnBackdrop
options.description: Backdrop click requests close (cancelable). Modal only.

options.name: direction
options.description: Maps start/end placement to a physical edge; applied as the element's dir.

properties.name: modal
properties.description: Whether the drawer was created modal.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Open (modal: showModal() and scroll lock; non-modal: show()); moves focus inside and captures focus for restoration.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge and apply options (all except modal).

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Close if open, remove element, listeners, overlay registration, subscriptions.

events.name: aui-cancel
events.description: Before a user-initiated close; preventDefault keeps it open.

cssClasses.name: aui-drawer
cssClasses.description: Native <dialog> element; data-aui-side holds the physical edge (left | right | top | bottom).
